title: 第7章 提升实力第8章 福运酒楼
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 萧风回到了书房，让许褚守在了门外，赵云和高凯去看禁卫军的布防了，他拿出洗髓丹，看着说明，只要服下即可，便直接将洗髓丹送入口中，但是紧接着，全是开始那种蚀骨的痛楚便开始在全身蔓延，随后便昏死了过去。
一刻钟之后，躺在地下的萧风缓缓地睁开了双眼，这时的萧风体质可以说是更上一层楼了，不但将体内的毒素全部排干净，还将体质重新淬炼了一下。
萧风打开房门让人将书房打扫干净，自己去泡了个澡，然后打开了仓库中放着的那本【太初混沌诀】直接便开始了修炼。
一天之后，萧风睁开了双眼，自己终于能修炼了，不愧是系统出品的功法，就是厉害，但他还是将皇帝送给他的【玄黄经】也修炼了，因为不想暴露自己的功法，所以必须也要修炼皇室的功法，来掩盖一下。
接着萧风又拿起了【青莲剑歌】，开始了修炼，像是个不知疲惫的机器人。
又过了两天，萧风从修炼中回过神来，觉得自己现在充满了力量，随后便打开了自己的属下面板：
姓名：萧风
身份：旭日王朝七皇子
年龄：十八岁（差24天）
职位：无
根骨资质：天阶巅峰
天赋：天阶巅峰（全系功法融合）
修为：黄阶三级
功法：太初混沌诀、玄黄经
武技：青莲剑歌、霸刀诀
势力：汉王府、不良人
抽奖点：500点
看着自己的面板，还是很欣慰的，毕竟才几天的时间，从一个手无缚鸡之力的落魄皇子，到现在的汉王，总归是有点起色的。
萧风走出门外，看见许褚，便问道：“他们几个人呢？”
“回少爷，赵云在调教高凯和那些禁卫军，曹公公在前厅，贾诩在教小丫头下棋，袁天罡从那天走了暂时还没有联络。”
“嗯，咱们也去前厅看看。”随后萧风便直接走向了前厅，到达前厅的时候，正看见曹正淳在调教小顺子，两人见萧风到了，赶忙上前行礼。萧风却摆了摆手，坐在了正位，开口道：“最近有什么事情吗？”
“回少爷，没有什么大事，就是昨天奴才去买了些佣人。”曹正淳回道。
“嗯，这些小事就不要再说了，你看着办就行。”
“殿下，您出来了，小丫头担心死了，要不是师傅不让我进书房去找你，我早就冲进去了。”小丫头，飞奔地向萧风跑过来。
“好了，小丫头，给你起个名字吧，要不然老是小丫头小丫头的叫，也不好听。”
“好呀好呀，殿下，给我起一个吧。”
content_en:
Xiao Feng returned to the study and asked Xu Chu to guard the door. Zhao Yun and Gao Kai went to see the defense of the imperial guards. He took out the marrow-cleansing pill, read the instructions, and just took it, then directly put the marrow-cleansing pill into his mouth. But then, the same bone-eroding pain began to spread throughout his body, and then he passed out.
A quarter of an hour later, Xiao Feng, who was lying on the ground, slowly opened his eyes. At this time, Xiao Feng's physique could be said to have improved to a higher level. Not only had all the toxins in his body been eliminated, but his physique had also been re-tempered.
Xiao Feng opened the door and asked someone to clean the study. He went to take a bath himself, then opened the book "The Jue of Taichu Chaos" placed in the warehouse and started practicing directly.
One day later, Xiao Feng opened his eyes. He was finally able to practice. It was indeed a system-produced technique and it was powerful. However, he still practiced the [Xuanhuang Sutra] given to him by the emperor. Because he did not want to expose his own technique, he had to practice the royal family's technique to cover it up.
Then Xiao Feng picked up [Qinglian Sword Song] again and started practicing, like a tireless robot.
Two days later, Xiao Feng came back from his training and felt that he was now full of strength. Then he opened his subordinate panel:
Name: Xiao Feng
Identity: Seventh Prince of the Rising Sun Dynasty
Age: 18 years old (24 days difference)
Position: None
Root Qualification: Peak of Heaven Level
Talent: Peak of Heaven Level (Integration of All Skills)
Cultivation level: Yellow level three
Kung Fu: Taichu Chaos Jue, Xuanhuang Sutra
Martial Arts: Qinglian Sword Song, Overlord Sword Technique
Power: Han Palace, Bad People
Lottery points: 500 points
Looking at his own dashboard, he was still very pleased. After all, in just a few days, he had gone from a down-and-out prince with no power to the current King of Han. After all, he had made some progress.
Xiao Feng walked out of the door and saw Xu Chu, so he asked: "How many of them are there?"
"Back to the young master, Zhao Yun is training Gao Kai and the Imperial Guards, Eunuch Cao is in the front hall, Jia Xu is teaching the little girl to play chess, and Yuan Tiangang has left since that day and there is no contact yet."
"Well, let's go to the front hall and have a look." Then Xiao Feng walked directly to the front hall. When he arrived at the front hall, he saw Cao Zhengchun training Xiao Shunzi. When the two of them saw Xiao Feng arriving, they hurried forward to salute. Xiao Feng waved his hand, sat down, and said, "What happened recently?"
"Master, it's nothing serious. I just went to buy some servants yesterday." Cao Zhengchun replied.
"Well, don't talk about these little things anymore, just do what you want."
"Your Highness, you are out. The little girl is worried to death. If the master hadn't let me go into the study to find you, I would have rushed in long ago." The little girl ran towards Xiao Feng at full speed.
"Okay, little girl, let's give you a name, otherwise it won't sound good if you keep calling me little girl."
"Okay, okay, Your Highness, give me one."
